title: The Three Begettings of the Flesh
description: All fleshly life classified under three modes of begetting (sexual joining, fall of the abortions, self-molding from the ground), each traceable to its corresponding enthumesis. The trees illustrate Hyle's enthumesis lodged at different depths (root, branch, seed). The names "virgin" and "continent" are then expounded at four ascending registers (celestial Light untouched / mingled-and-returned / Mind of Light bearing elect / regenerate man stripped of Sin), ending with the New Man who has stripped himself of the somatic dragon.
